variants.title: Building directory with floor plan
variants.navigation: Stable directory/preparation/route links, plan letters matched to directory entries, local search and real guide destinations.

ordered_sections.pattern: Arrival statement beside an original floor plan with a you-are-here mark
Four lettered signage columns with a compact search toolbar
Heading beside three lettered native disclosures

variants.mobile_reflow: Plan moves under the arrival text at full width; directory becomes two then one column; search controls stack; the route track turns vertical.
distinguishing_features: Floor plan as the orientation object
Letter tiles linking plan and directory
Search as a toolbar, not a hero

variants.title: Area guide with route rail
variants.navigation: Breadcrumb to the directory, a numbered route rail for the guide sections and a directory return.

ordered_sections.pattern: Area sign, specific title and a zoomed plan of the two rooms
Definition list keyed to the plan room codes

variants.mobile_reflow: Plan follows the title; the route rail moves above the document; the review track turns vertical; text stays full size.
distinguishing_features: Single-area zoom instead of the whole building
Vertical route rail beside a reading column
Room codes shared by plan and options
